facts.text: Shutter.get_slot() asks the motor for its position and converts the pulse position to a slot number
Shutter.set_slot(1) moves the slider backward and set_slot(2) moves it forward; any other slot value returns None without a move
Shutter.open() selects slot 2 and Shutter.close() selects slot 1 when the shutter was not created inverted; inverted=True swaps the two
Shutter.is_open() and Shutter.is_closed() compare the current slot with 2 and 1, swapped when the shutter was created inverted
pos_to_slot computes the slot as position / (range / (slots - 1)) + 1 from the slot count the device database holds for the motor type
The device database lists ELL6 as a Dual-Position Slider with 2 slots at positions 0 and 31
Motor.home() moves the motor with the clockwise or anticlockwise homing command
The movement instruction table maps 'home_clockwise' to ho0, 'home_anticlockwise' to ho1, 'forward' to fw, 'backward' to bw, 'absolute' to ma and 'relative' to mr
Motor.load_motor_info() queries the 'info' response when the object is created and stores the motor range, pulses per revolution, serial number and motor type
The controller composes a command from the bus address, the instruction bytes and an optional signed 32-bit big-endian hex argument
The README homes the shutter before use and opens and closes it with open() and close()
The README lists the Dual-Position Slider (ELL6) as useful as a shutter
